entry.title: Academic Life
entry.content:
Hi, I'm Zoe

Welcome to my journal. Reflecting on my academic journey, I’ve noticed a recurring pattern of deep learning every five years.

From ages 7 to 12, I focused on competitive math. I was very proud to get some money reward every single year from doing this. Afterward, as soon as I was introduced to Physics, I loved it. I spent the first year simply getting acquainted with the subject. That led to five years of competitive physics from ages 13 to 18, during which I was part of a gifted class in high school.

However, pursuing a career in science wasn’t encouraged in Vietnam where I grew up, so I didn’t continue in that field. I also came to realize that life is much more than theory.

Now, as I work in data science, I find myself looking back on everything I’ve done that has led me to this point and how it all connects.

entry.title: Welcome
entry.content:
Hi, I'm Zoe

Welcome to my blog! If you don't know me. You can learn more about my journey here.

I’m an AI Engineer with a Master in Data Science from USF.

Before diving into Data Science, I worked for a leading resort chain in Phu Quoc, Vietnam, where I carried out business analysis. I found myself fascinated with data patterns and proposed ideas to improve the business through statistical reports. During my time there, the company earned 9 World Travel Awards. When the pandemic hit, I was lucky to shelter in Silicon Valley. I was selected as a section leader for Stanford’s Code in Place, covering half of the CS106A 🌲. This was a dream come true and my favorite in terms of learning and teaching experience with Python. Since then, I’ve worked as a machine learning engineer, developing models, and creating visualizations across multiple industries such as e-commerce, education, and travel. (Check out my projects 👀) I'm passionate about learning and seeking new challenges!

My favourite Shakespeare's quote: "To be, or not to be" 🌿 My motto: Love Live Laugh, Touch Grass.

I do my work with passion. Outside of machine learning and data science, I spend my time gardening, playing sports with friends, traveling, and enjoying having a good laugh.

Great things are coming!
